finding.message: The application was found calling the `eval` function OR Function()   constructor OR setTimeout() OR setInterval() methods.
finding.lineText: const consume = new Function('createHash', 'requireString', `${executable}\nreturn signalPlanForPath;`)(createHash, requireString);

decision.reason: No untrusted input reaches executable source in this exact occurrence. The Function body is a TypeScript transpilation of four fixed top-level functions from the already trusted, already imported repository workflow module plus a constant return statement. SQLite fixture values are passed later as data arguments, never interpolated into the generated program.

dataFlow: Code origin: readFile(new URL(../src/workflow_repository.ts, import.meta.url)) is a fixed repository-relative file; path does not depend on HTTP requests, DB rows, CLI arguments, environment, test values or remote responses.

Selection: current AST contains exactly four named top-level FunctionDeclarations. Their source consists of object shape checks, recursive canonical JSON/hash, and a pure compiled-plan projection using requireString. No nested eval/Function, dynamic import, shell or network call exists in these bodies.

Construction: getText(parsed) plus newline joins feeds transpileModule. The sole interpolation into Function body is this trusted source string; final return signalPlanForPath is constant. Dependency parameters are the imported node:crypto createHash and fixed repository requireString, not user-controlled constructors.

Data: after constructing consume, publishedPath comes from the local paper workflow fixture and JSON roundtrip. Object/array/17 malformed variants, five falsy optional variants and whitespace prompt are passed into consume(changed, first.id). Their values never enter executable or Function constructor input.

Fixture: initDb uses private mkdtemp path; workflowFixture seeds deterministic standard contracts/strategies and two paper accounts, then publishes a local graph. No operational DB or live provider is used. DB immutability/integrity is not disabled for this probe. The later missing-run database.get override is restored in finally and cannot alter source construction.

Caller: tests/run_all.js lists this standalone test; module executes only in test process. Production workflow_repository is already statically imported at test line10. An attacker allowed to replace that repository file already controls imported test executable code; Function is not an additional data-to-code boundary. This is an explicit trust assumption, not a claim the constructor is sandboxed.
limitations: Individual occurrence only; no rule/file-wide exemption or blanket approval of dynamic execution.
Source review and AST/hash verification only; no fresh CPU-heavy suite run or live platform disposition.
Any later change to source origin, selected functions, template interpolation or injected dependencies requires new review.
Historical test execution evidence remains separate; this report does not renew implementation receipt or provider acceptance.
